_key.description: SPDI of the variant on GRCm39. A VRS digest is used when the SPDI is longer than 256 characters.

chr.title: Chromosome
chr.description: Chromosome of the variant, prefixed with chr. Scaffolds and patch regions use UCSC-style names.

rsid.title: dbSNP ID
rsid.description: dbSNP ids from the VCF ID column. Empty when that column is '.'.

strain.title: Strain
strain.description: Collaborative Cross founder strains that carry the alternate allele.

qual.title: Variant Call Quality
qual.description: VCF QUAL score for the variant position.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: VCF FILTER for the site. PASS if at least one strain call passed the release filters; LowQual otherwise. Null when the source has none.

fi.title: Filter Index
fi.description: Per-strain filter index from the VCF FORMAT field: 1 if the genotype passed all filters, 0 if it failed one or more. Heterozygous calls are marked 0 in this release. Null when the FORMAT FI value is missing ('.').

spdi.title: SPDI
spdi.description: Normalized SPDI expression identifying the allele.

hgvs.title: HGVS
hgvs.description: HGVS genomic expression for the allele.

accessible_via.simplified_return: _id, chr, pos, rsid, ref, alt, strain, spdi, hgvs
accessible_via.return: _id, chr, pos, rsid, ref, alt, organism, name, spdi, hgvs, qual, filter, fi, strain, source, source_url

threshold: No statistical significance cutoff is applied. The adapter retains nonmissing, non-reference genotype calls (excluding ./. and 0/0); source filter and fi quality annotations are preserved without a numerical cutoff.
